annotations.title: Add a photo or video from a link

description: Add one picture or video by its public web address instead of sending the file: PNG, JPEG, WebP or MP4, up to 10 MB. The service fetches it once and stores it; answers its media id, as media_upload does. Use it when the user points at a file that is already online. Refused when the address is not a public https one, cannot be fetched, is too large, or leads to a page instead of a file.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the address when left out.

url.description: The https address of the file itself, one that opens the picture or video in a browser without signing in. Not the address of a page that shows it.

name: media_from_url
title: Add a photo or video from a link
